current.text: Experts rank him around 8th to 10th in category leagues, below his Yahoo rank of 5. Taking him at pick 5 is a mild overpay; pick 6 or 7 is fine.
Auction price calls differ. Josh would pay no more than 45 USD. Another expert values him at about 50 USD.
He went for 48 USD in an expert auction mock draft.
Experts rank him below consensus in 9-cat because of his shaky FG% and FT%. They want his FT% back above 85%. A bigger offensive load could hurt his efficiency further.
Detroit lost creation when Tobias Harris left and has very few creators besides Cade.
His usage may rise from about 31 after the roster changes. He led his group in potential assists, so his assists could go over 10 per game unless Daniss Jenkins takes a bigger role.
Detroit wants him to take more catch-and-shoot threes, with Ausar Thompson running some of the offense.
Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest. A team preview found no notable injuries on the roster.
One expert is not particularly worried about his injury history.
Detroit plays 4-3-4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest is expected.
Detroit is projected to win 50 to 51 games and finish third or fourth in the East.

durable.text: Assists are his standout category, about 10 per game and far above the player pool.
He commits many turnovers, about 4 per game. That is a league-wide weakness even for a lead guard.
His weaker categories are FG%, rebounds and blocks. His free throws are fine but not a strength.
He carries a heavy creation load, which hurts his finishing and his two-point percentage.
He is worth more in points leagues than in 9-cat, where turnovers and middling percentages hold him back.
His injury history is spotty. He has had lower-body problems in recent years and a punctured lung at the end of last season.

note: On average he costs 63.1 USD on Yahoo and 57.5 USD on ESPN, and he went for 55 USD in our league last season. Experts value him at 45 to 50 USD and rank him 8th to 10th in categories, so let someone else pay Yahoo prices. He is an assist anchor whose 3.9 turnovers per game are the worst part of his line, so he fits best in a punt TO build. Early in the season, check whether his FT% gets back toward 85% and whether his usage rises with Tobias Harris gone.
